name: kanban-iso-compliance
description: Sistema Kanban ISO 9001/27001 Compliant con Onboarding/Offboarding e SLA Tracking

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed

author: Europoligrafico
